desc:
LOW RANGE | EARLY ACCESS

A slow, technical offroad driving game. Each stage is one trail from start to finish, inspired by real offroad tracks around the world. Speed won't get you through. Reading the ground and setting up your truck will.

HOW IT PLAYS

- PICK YOUR LINE: mud, roots, rock and water all change how your truck grips and climbs.
- SET UP YOUR TRUCK: air down your tires, lock the diffs and drop into low range when the trail gets hard.
- WINCH OUT: stuck? Hook a tree or a friend's truck and pull yourself free.
- MANAGE YOUR FUEL: 4WD burns more. Fuel caches on the trail fill your tank and act as checkpoints.
- MUD THAT REMEMBERS: ruts get deeper with every truck that passes, for everyone on the server.

Drive solo or with friends, help each other through the hard parts, and come back to beat your best times.

Keyboard, mouse and controller supported.

Early access: things will change and some will break.
